t: Macpherson Contract Matt Emulsion Paint provides a high obliterating, brilliant white finish for interior walls and ceilings. This quick-drying emulsion is ideal for trade professionals working on new plaster, allowing surfaces to dry within 1-2 hours and be recoated in 2-4 hours, ensuring project efficiency. Its good opacity helps achieve excellent coverage of up to 13m²/Ltr, making it a reliable choice for various indoor applications, including residential and commercial spaces.
